title: Twin degraded (controller TC13, synthetic)
purpose: Forecast-triggered warming is running when Twin_Valid becomes DEGRADED at 300 s: TWIN_DEGRADED.MONITOR, all heat 0, no autonomous warming; the twin is VALID again from 600 s and the controller returns to NORMAL after t_recover_s (630 s).
data_source: Controller: Suchitha's supervisory controller test TC13 (SIMULATED test bench, controller/neram_ctrl). Twin fields: test-bench stand-in values the controller received (SIMULATED).
loop_description: Open loop: synthetic twin input, no patient plant.
limitations: Synthetic twin input values; the degradation is scripted.

Controller: Suchitha's supervisory controller design (v2 specification); Python fallback code rebuilt by Sai on 18 Oct 2026 from that specification (reproduces her v2 logs byte for byte). Not a Simulink/Stateflow model.

Twin fields are test-bench stand-ins (synthetic inputs or a first-order filter stand-in), NOT the NERAM twin. The forecast is the stand-in's flat persistence (T_pred = T_est) with normal bands from T_est_sd.
Hardware signals and module temperatures come from test stand-ins; no hardware exists. Thresholds are placeholders (Shreehan, TBD).
No clinical, hardware or treatment claim is made.
